subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should this issue require preserving and resuming partial assistant output, or should shipped abort-and-next-turn `interrupt` behavior be the supported soft-steer contract?
rationale: Current behavior solves immediate redirection through cancellation and continuation, but resumable partial generation would create a broader permanent lifecycle contract across backends and in-flight tools.

options.title: Adopt interrupt semantics
options.body: Define soft steer as aborting the active run and immediately continuing with the newest message in the same session, without promising partial-generation resume.

options.title: Require resumable output
options.body: Keep this issue as a broader runtime project for checkpointing and resuming partial generation and in-flight work across supported backends.

recommendation.title: Adopt interrupt semantics
recommendation.body: Define soft steer as aborting the active run and immediately continuing with the newest message in the same session, without promising partial-generation resume.

likelyOwner.reason: The original queue behavior, later policy work, and prior issue review make this the strongest available product-direction owner.
